exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to cover (from above, e.g. with a lid)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: сокро́вище — treasure (collection of valuable things); покрыва́ть — to cover; покро́в — cover, covering; накры́ть — to cover (from above, e.g. with a lid).

**Накрой** — накры́ть (perfective): to cover (from above, e.g. with a lid); (military) to hit, to place fire on a target, to trap (from above, e.g. of artillery fire or bombing); (intransitive, ) to lay (a table); (colloquial) to catch (in the act). Wiktionary: на- + крыть.

pairs: roofing, roof covering, rooftop (the outer surface of a roof)
to cover oneself, to get covered
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: покрови́тельство — patronage, protection; кро́вля — roofing, roof covering, rooftop (the outer surface of a roof); укры́ться — to cover/wrap oneself; покры́ться — to cover oneself, to get covered.
**покрылся** — покры́ться (perfective): to cover oneself, to get covered; to be covered (with). Wiktionary: покры́ть + -ся.
